facts.fact: Prime Minister Amadou Oury Bah's government plans to use AI in digitalised public procurement to check road-construction prices against INS data and ACGP assessments and flag overbilling, with Rwandan technical support, to be operational by the end of the year.
facts.system: AI price control for public procurement
